name: Monte Carlo Estimation of Differentiable Path Integrals
definition: Estimates the gradient of the path integral with respect to parameters π by splitting the derivative into interior contributions (derivative of the path contribution function) and boundary contributions (derivative of the visibility boundary).
summary: Monte Carlo Estimation of Differentiable Path Integrals computes gradients by combining interior path derivatives with explicit boundary terms for silhouette and shadow edges, handling discontinuities that naive methods miss.
